C0553.title: Buyer Exploits 'Refund-Only' Loophole in Repeated 'Wool-Pulling' Incident
C0553.summary: A merchant, Mr. Cheng, encountered a buyer who maliciously exploited the 'refund-only' rule twice. The buyer first uploaded a photo on one platform to successfully request a refund-only, then used the same photo on another platform to apply for another refund-only, repeatedly obtaining both the goods and refunds.
